mutants.name: agent filter bypassed (raw agent list passed through)
mutants.old: nr_agents=$(ck_herdr_agents "$nr_session" --access) || ck_die 1 "herdr: cannot list the agents"
mutants.new: nr_agents=$(_ck_herdr_list "$nr_session" agent) || ck_die 1 "herdr: cannot list the agents"

mutants.name: role fallback removed
mutants.old: .role = (.role // (if $lm | index($i) then "lead" elif $bm | index($i) then "bridge" else null end))

mutants.name: node state not validated
mutants.old: jq -s -e --arg s "$nr_session" "length == 1 and (.[0] | $NR_STATE_CHECK)" "$nr_copy" > /dev/null 2>&1 || ck_die 65 "node state is invalid"

mutants.name: name fallback matches every agent
mutants.old: if ($n | length) == 1 then $n else [] end end
mutants.new: if ($n | length) >= 1 then $n else [] end end
